windshield_rule: No material that reduces light transmission through the windshield, except a transparent item that is not red or amber placed on the uppermost 6 inches of the windshield
measured: film and glass together (light transmission 'through the rear windshield or side windows')
tolerance: at least 3% (statute: 'with a measurement tolerance of at least 3 percent')
statutes: Ala. Code 32-5C-2; Ala. Code 32-5C-1; Ala. Code 32-5C-3; Ala. Code 32-5C-4; Ala. Code 32-5C-5; Ala. Code 32-5C-6; Ala. Code 32-5C-7

windshield_rule: Eyebrow strip on the top edge that does not extend more than 5 inches down from the top of the glass; no other aftermarket tint on the windshield
banned_colors: any color other than green, gray, bronze or neutral smoke (a sun reflective auto film is also allowed)
measured: film and glass together ('through a window, including glazing')
tolerance: 3% (allowance for manufacturing variances of plus or minus three percent; meter accuracy certified by its manufacturer)
rear_window_condition: A tinted rear window is exempt if the owner has proof it was tinted before July 1, 1994 and the vehicle has driver-side and passenger-side mirrors (13 AAC 04.223(h))

windshield_rule: Transparent material on the topmost part of the windshield is allowed if its bottom edge is at least 29 inches above the undepressed driver's seat (measured 5 inches in front of the bottom of the backrest, seat rearmost and lowest, vehicle level) and it is not red or amber
measured: film and glass together ('including the glazing')
rear_window_condition: Back side and rear windows have no light-transmission limit but need luminous reflectance of 35% plus or minus 3% or less; a rear window is fully exempt if the vehicle has outside mirrors on both sides showing the road at least 200 feet behind (28-959.01(A)(6), (A)(10))

windshield_rule: Eyebrow strip on the top edge that does not extend more than 5 inches down from the top center of the windshield; no other aftermarket windshield tint (with a medical certification, windshield film of at least 50% is allowed)
measured: net light transmission (tint 'which results in at least ... net light transmission'); term not defined in the sections read
statutes: Ark. Code Ann. 27-37-306; Ark. Code Ann. 27-37-307; Ark. Code Ann. 27-37-304; Ark. Code Ann. 27-37-302

windshield_rule: Transparent material on the topmost part of the windshield is allowed if its bottom edge is at least 29 inches above the undepressed driver's seat (measured 5 inches in front of the bottom of the backrest, seat rearmost and lowest, vehicle level), it is not red or amber, has no opaque lettering, and reflects no more glare than the windshield alone
measured: Front side: the film alone must have at least 88% visible light transmittance and the window with the film at least 70% (FMVSS 205)
rear_window_condition: The rear window is exempt only if the vehicle has outside mirrors on both sides showing the road at least 200 feet behind (26708(b)(8))
statutes: Cal. Veh. Code 26708; Cal. Veh. Code 26708.2; Cal. Veh. Code 26708.5

windshield_rule: Nontransparent material may be applied to the topmost part of the windshield if its bottom edge is no more than 4 inches from the top, it is not red or amber, does not distort vision or carry obstructing lettering, and reflects no more glare than the windshield alone; the windshield must allow at least 70% light transmittance
measured: the window as a whole (a window that 'allows less than twenty-seven percent light transmittance'); not otherwise defined
rear_window_condition: Windows to the rear of the driver, including the rear window, may be darker than 27% if the front side windows and the windshield allow at least 70% (42-4-227(1)(a)(II))

windshield_rule: Transparent material on the topmost part of the windshield is allowed if its bottom edge is at least 29 inches above the undepressed driver's seat (measured 5 inches in front of the bottom of the backrest, seat rearmost and lowest, vehicle level) and it is not red or amber
measured: film and glass together ('including the glazing')
tolerance: 3% (stated as 'plus or minus three per cent')
rear_window_condition: The rearmost window has no limit only if the vehicle has outside mirrors on both sides showing the road at least 200 feet behind; without them it must meet 35% plus or minus 3%. On trucks, buses and MPVs the same mirrors free all windows behind the driver (14-99g(c)(5), (6), (10))

windshield_rule: Tint may be applied along the top edge of the windshield if it is transparent and does not encroach on the AS-1 portion of the windshield (FMVSS 205)
measured: Not stated: the text sets the visible light transmission of 'the window tint or other material'

windshield_rule: The windshield must allow at least 70% light transmittance (55% on a mini-van); tint darker than that is allowed above the AS-1 line or within 5 inches from the top of the windshield
measured: the window as a whole (windows that 'allow less than' the percent); light transmittance not defined

windshield_rule: Only a transparent sunscreening strip along the top of the windshield that does not go into the AS-1 area defined in FMVSS 205
measured: film and glass together, tested on the glass of the specific vehicle
rear_window_condition: If the rear window is made nontransparent, the vehicle needs side mirrors on both sides (s. 316.294)

windshield_rule: No material that reduces light transmission, except a transparent item that is not red or amber on the uppermost 6 in of the windshield
measured: film and glass together ('material and glazing')
rear_window_condition: Rear windshield and rear side/door windows are exempt on multipurpose passenger vehicles, certain buses and nonprofit vans, limousines, and any vehicle tinted before factory delivery

windshield_rule: Transparent film along the top edge only, not into the AS-1 area; if no AS-1 mark, no lower than 4 in below the top (measured from the middle of the top moulding)
reflectivity_front_side: No % set; mirrored or high-reflective finishes with a red, yellow, amber or blue appearance barred
measured: film and glass together ('when used in conjunction with the glazing material')
rear_window_condition: Rear window and side windows behind the driver are exempt only if the vehicle has rearview mirrors on both sides
statutes: Haw. Rev. Stat. 291-21.5; 2025 Haw. Sess. Laws Act 129 (HB 226 CD1)

windshield_rule: Nonreflective film only above the AS-1 line; if no AS-1 line, not below a line 6 in down from the top
measured: film (the statute defines light transmission for 'the product or material'; glass not mentioned)

windshield_rule: Nonreflective tinted film only along the top, no more than 6 in down from the top
measured: not stated; the film must 'allow at least' the % of light, as metered by law enforcement
rear_window_condition: Front side film at 35% is allowed only if no window behind the driver is below 35%; front film at 50% only if none is below 30%; with factory-tinted rear glass the front film must be at least 50%. If the front side windows are untreated, rear windows have no % limit, but any treated rear window requires side mirrors on both sides

windshield_rule: Film only on the uppermost part of the windshield, no further down than the AS-1 line, within the 30% transmittance / 25% reflectance limits
measured: not stated; reflectance is 'measured on the nonfilm side', which points to a reading on the window with film

windshield_rule: No tint-strip exception in the law; the windshield must let through at least 70% of light
measured: the window itself ('minimum standard of transparency' of the windshield or side window), so film and glass together
statutes: Iowa Code 321.438 as amended by 2026 Iowa Acts ch. 1100 (HF 766); Iowa Admin. Code 761-450.5; Iowa Code 805.8A(3)(ai)

windshield_rule: Nonreflective film only along the top, not below the AS1 line; not red, yellow or amber
measured: film and glass together (light transmission includes 'any safety glazing material')

windshield_rule: A transparent strip at the top is allowed if it does not encroach on the AS/1 portion (FMVSS 205); material on the rest of the windshield is allowed only if, with the windshield glass, it lets through at least 70% and is not red or yellow
reflectivity_front_side: 25% max (total solar reflectance of visible light, nonfilm side)
measured: film tested on 1/8-inch clear glass ('when tested on one-eighth (1/8) inch clear glass'); the windshield 70% figure is with the windshield glazing; perforated film is tested with the existing glazing
tolerance: 3% (stated as 'plus or minus three percent (3%)' for every percentage in subsections (2) to (4))
rear_window_condition: If the rear window is made nontransparent, the vehicle needs side mirrors on both sides

windshield_rule: A transparent material, not red or amber, on the topmost part of the windshield, extending no more than 5 inches down from the top; no other material that alters color or reduces light transmission
measured: film and glass together ('light transmission' includes 'any glazing material'; device used 'in conjunction with automotive safety glazing materials')
tolerance: none beyond the stated limits (each limit is 'all tolerances included')

windshield_rule: Tint allowed above the AS-1 line, or in a 5-inch strip at the top if the windshield has no AS-1 line; otherwise no material that reduces light transmittance below the original or original-replacement windshield
reflectivity_front_side: No reflective material on any window
reflectivity_back_side: No reflective material on any window
measured: film and glass together ('35% net of glass and material')
rear_window_condition: Side windows behind the driver and the rear window are free of the 35% limit only if the vehicle has 2 outside rear view mirrors, one on each side; without them the 35% limit applies to those windows too

windshield_rule: No post-manufacture tint below the AS1 line or below 5 inches from the top of the windshield ('whichever is less' in COMAR); the law gives no light transmittance figure for the strip
reflectivity_front_side: No mirrored, one-way vision or sparkling effect (COMAR)
reflectivity_back_side: No mirrored, one-way vision or sparkling effect (COMAR)
measured: film and glass together ('light transmittance through the window of at least 35%'; COMAR: 'at least 35 percent light transmittance after the application')
rear_window_condition: Any vehicle with post-manufacture tint on a side or rear window needs an outside rearview mirror on each side; no tint on the part of the rear window in front of an inside-mounted high stop lamp

windshield_rule: Transparent material only in the uppermost 6 inches, not encroaching on the driver's direct forward viewing area (FMVSS); inspection rule: no tint lower than the AS-1 line, usually within the top 6 inches
measured: film and glass together per the state inspection guideline (meter reading 'through both the window and the tint film'); the statute's wording refers to the material
rear_window_condition: If the rear window has aftermarket tint, the vehicle needs two outside mirrors, one on each side

windshield_rule: Tinted film only along the top edge, not more than 4 inches from the top of the windshield or lower than the shade band, whichever is closer to the top; no other film or reflective material
reflectivity_front_side: No reflective film (only a tinted strip in the top 4 inches)
reflectivity_back_side: Less than 35% total solar reflectance (35% or more, including silver or gold reflective film, is prohibited)
measured: not applicable (the statute sets no light transmittance percentage)
rear_window_condition: If the view through the rear window is obstructed, the vehicle needs 2 rearview mirrors, 1 on each side

windshield_rule: No material that makes the windshield more reflective or reduces its light transmittance in any way; the law gives no top-strip exception (only original FMVSS 205 glazing is exempt)
reflectivity_front_side: 20% max luminous reflectance (plus or minus 3%); no highly reflective or mirrored appearance
reflectivity_back_side: 20% max luminous reflectance (plus or minus 3%); no highly reflective or mirrored appearance
measured: the window as treated (a side or rear window that 'has a light transmittance of less than 50 percent'); not stated as film alone
tolerance: 3% (stated as '50 percent plus or minus three percent' and '20 percent plus or minus three percent')
statutes: Minn. Stat. 169.71 subd. 4, 4a, 5; Minn. Stat. 168.002 subd. 26, 40

windshield_rule: No tinted film or darkening material of any kind on the windshield, except material that replaces or provides a sun shield in the uppermost area as manufacturers may install under federal law
reflectivity_front_side: No glazing material that causes a mirrored effect
reflectivity_back_side: No glazing material that causes a mirrored effect
measured: the window as tinted ('all the windows of the vehicle have a light transmittance of twenty-eight percent (28%) or more'), tested by an official tint inspection station
statutes: Miss. Code Ann. 63-7-59; Miss. Code Ann. 63-7-7

windshield_rule: All sun-screening devices on the windshield are prohibited, except tinting on the upper portion of the windshield that is normally tinted by the manufacturer of safety glass (no inch limit or AS-1 line in the statute)
measured: film and glass together (sun-screening device 'in conjunction with safety glazing material')

windshield_rule: Only clear and transparent sunscreening material below the AS-1 line; above the AS-1 line material may not be red, yellow or amber (no VLT or inch limit stated)
reflectivity_back_side: 35% max (not for multipurpose vehicles, vans or buses)
measured: Not stated as film alone: 'light transmission' is light passing through 'the sunscreening or transparent material' compared with total light falling on the window; the limits also apply to factory-tinted windows with added film (61-9-405(6))

windshield_rule: Only clear and transparent sunscreening below the AS-1 line; the AS-1 line is the AS-1 mark or a line 5 in below the top, whichever is closer to the top; above it the material may not be red, yellow or amber (no VLT stated)
reflectivity_back_side: 35% max (not for multipurpose vehicles, vans or buses)
measured: Not stated as film alone: 'light transmission' is light passing through 'the sunscreening or transparent material' compared with total light falling on the window
statutes: Neb. Rev. Stat. 60-6,257; Neb. Rev. Stat. 60-6,258; Neb. Rev. Stat. 60-6,259; Neb. Rev. Stat. 60-6,260; Neb. Rev. Stat. 60-6,261

windshield_rule: Transparent material only on the topmost portion, with its bottom edge at least 29 in above the undepressed driver's seat (measured 5 in in front of the backrest, seat rearmost and lowest); not red or amber; no VLT stated
measured: film and glass together ('total light transmission through the combination, if any, of transparent material and safety glazing')
rear_window_condition: Side windows behind the driver and the rear window are free of limits only if the vehicle has outside mirrors on each side showing the driver the highway at least 200 ft to the rear

windshield_rule: No aftermarket tint on the windshield, except a strip at the very top no wider than 6 in with light transmittance of at least 35%
measured: Light transmittance 'of after-market tinted windows' (the tinted window as a whole); not stated as film alone
rear_window_condition: If aftermarket tint is applied to windows behind the driver, outside rear-view mirrors are required on both the left and right sides
statutes: RSA 266:58-a; RSA 266:61-a; N.H. Code Admin. R. Saf-C 3217.06

windshield_rule: No aftermarket film on the windshield without an MVC medical exemption. With an exemption: clear film only, at least 70% with factory glass below the AS-1 line, no minimum above the AS-1 line, reflectance 8% max, and a 6 x 8 in lower-left area kept clear for the inspection sticker
measured: film and factory glass together for medical-exemption film ('in conjunction with factory-installed glazing', N.J.A.C. 13:20-1.2; 'Transmittance' definition in 13:20-1.1)

windshield_rule: Nonreflective, not red, yellow or amber, and only along the top, not below the AS-1 line or more than 5 in from the top, whichever is closer to the top (no VLT stated)
measured: Not stated as film alone: 20% applies to sun screening 'used in conjunction with the safety glazing materials'; 'light transmission' is defined for 'a product or material'
rear_window_condition: Film on any side or rear window (front sides included) is allowed only on a vehicle with one right and one left outside rearview mirror

windshield_rule: Material with light transmittance under 70% only in the uppermost 6 in of the windshield
measured: Not stated as film alone: windows 'composed of, covered by or treated with any material which has a light transmittance of less than seventy percent'; rear side rule refers to the window's light transmittance
rear_window_condition: The rear window may be below 70% only if the vehicle has side mirrors on both sides adjusted to give the driver a clear and full view of the road and traffic behind; otherwise 70% minimum

windshield_rule: Tint only along the top, no more than 5 in below the top or below the AS1 line, whichever measurement is longer; an untinted clear film that blocks UV may be applied to the rest of the windshield
measured: film and glass together ('total light transmission of the tinted window')
tolerance: A light-meter reading above 32% is 'conclusively presumed' to meet the 35% rule (20-127(b)(1))

windshield_rule: Nonreflective tint is allowed above the AS-1 line or within the top 5 in; any other material on the windshield must leave at least 70% light transmittance together with the windshield
measured: film and glass together (material 'in conjunction with' the windshield or window)
rear_window_condition: Windows behind the driver have no limit only if the vehicle has outside mirrors on both sides meeting 39-21-38 (view at least 200 ft to the rear); without them the 35% limit applies to those windows too

windshield_rule: Material along the top that does not extend below the AS-1 line or 5 in from the top, whichever is closer to the top, is not regulated; any other windshield material must give at least 70% (plus or minus 3%) with the glass and must not be red or yellow
measured: film and glass together ('when used in conjunction with the safety glazing materials')
rear_window_condition: Outside left and right rear-view mirrors are required if rear-window film gives less than 50% (plus or minus 3%) together with the glass
statutes: Ohio Rev. Code 4513.241; Ohio Admin. Code 4501-41-02; Ohio Admin. Code 4501-41-03; Ohio Admin. Code 4501-41-04; Ohio Admin. Code 4501-41-05

windshield_rule: Only transparent material on the topmost part, not below the AS-1 line or more than 5 in from the top, whichever is closer to the top, and not red or amber; no other material that alters color or reduces light on the windshield
measured: film and glass together (material 'in conjunction with glazing material'; 'Window' includes the glazing and film)
rear_window_condition: Vehicles made before the 1996 model year: side windows behind the driver and back windows may go to 10% (reflectance 25% max) if the vehicle has outside mirrors on both sides with a 200 ft rear view

windshield_rule: Darker tint only on the top 6 in; tinting material may not be applied to any other part of the windshield
measured: both: film alone at least 50%, and film plus glass at least 35% total
rear_window_condition: Multipurpose passenger vehicles may go darker on all windows behind the driver only if they have rearview mirrors on each side, and those windows must meet federal AS-3 glazing requirements

windshield_rule: Only transparent material along the top edge that does not encroach on the AS-1 portion and is no more than 3 in from the top; Table X sets 70% for the windshield
measured: film and glass together (Table X 'acceptable light transmittance levels for vehicle glazing')
tolerance: plus or minus 3% (Table X: levels 'assume a 3% accuracy')
rear_window_condition: If the rear window is treated, outside rearview mirrors on both sides are required (each at least 19.5 sq in). Pre-1998 passenger cars: rear-window film needs a permanent 'Complies with VESC-20' label instead of the 70% level
statutes: 75 Pa.C.S. 4524(e); 67 Pa. Code 175.67; 67 Pa. Code 175.80; 67 Pa. Code 175.261-175.265; 67 Pa. Code Chapter 175, Table X

windshield_rule: Transparent material only in the uppermost 6 in, not into the driver's direct forward viewing area defined by FMVSS; any other windshield material needs at least 70% total visible light transmittance
measured: film and glass together ('total visible light transmittance', 'measured perpendicular to the surface of the glass')
rear_window_condition: Rear-window material (70%) only if the vehicle has two outside mirrors, one on each side; trucks, multipurpose vehicles, buses, limousines and similar may have any sunscreen behind the driver only with two outside mirrors meeting federal standards

windshield_rule: Nonreflective tint only along the top, not below the AS1 line; if the AS1 line is not visible, no tint on the windshield
measured: film and glass together ('combined light transmission of the sunscreening device with the factory or manufacturer installed sunscreening material')
rear_window_condition: If the rear-most window is tinted, one right and one left outside rearview mirror are required

windshield_rule: No film may extend downward beyond the AS-1 line or below the lowest point of the sun visor; film on the windshield may not bring the combined light transmittance below 35% (enforcement tolerance 9%)
measured: film and glass together ('combined level'; light transmission is measured through 'the product or material and the glazing')

windshield_rule: Except for the manufacturer's standard installed shade band, material may not reduce the windshield's visible light transmittance below 70%; any added material must itself have at least 35% visible light transmittance
measured: material (film): the text bans 'any material that ... has a visible light transmittance of less than 35%'; the windshield 70% figure is the windshield's resulting transmittance
statutes: Tenn. Code Ann. 55-9-107; Tenn. Code Ann. 40-35-111

windshield_rule: Tint strip only above the AS-1 line or within 5 in of the top, whichever is closer to the top; with the windshield it must have 25% or more light transmission and 25% or less luminous reflectance and must not be red, blue or amber
measured: film and glass together ('in combination with the vent or window'; light transmission is through 'a material' compared with light falling on 'the material and the glazing')
tolerance: 3% (DPS may treat front side windows as exempt if transmission or reflectance varies by no more than 3%, 547.613(d))
rear_window_condition: Rear window tint is exempt only if the vehicle has an outside mirror on each side showing the highway at least 200 ft to the rear
statutes: Tex. Transp. Code 547.613; Tex. Transp. Code 547.609; Tex. Transp. Code 547.001; Tex. Transp. Code 542.401

windshield_rule: The windshield must allow at least 70% light transmittance; nontransparent material is allowed along the top edge if it extends no more than 4 in down from the top edge or beyond the AS-1 line, 'whichever is lowest', and in a lower left corner space no more than 3 in to the right and 4 in up
measured: film and glass together (the window that 'allows' the light transmittance)
tolerance: 5% variance for front side windows when metered by a peace officer (41-6a-1635(1)(b))
rear_window_condition: A vehicle with tinting or nontransparent material on any window (other than the allowed windshield strip and corner) must have rear-view mirrors on both the left and right sides

windshield_rule: No material may be painted or adhered on any transparent part of the windshield except in small listed spaces (4 x 12 in lower right corner, 2 x 2.5 in upper left corner, spaces set by the Commissioner for required stickers, dealer spaces, rearview mirror, toll transponder); the law has no tint-strip or AS-1 provision
measured: not applicable: the law sets no light transmission figure; it bans material on the windshield and front side windows
rear_window_condition: Rear side windows and the back window may be obstructed only if the vehicle has a securely attached mirror on each side giving a clear view of the roadway to the rear and on both sides
statutes: 23 V.S.A. § 1125; 2025 Acts and Resolves No. 66, Sec. 38; 2024 Acts and Resolves No. 165, Secs. 14-16 (deleted before taking effect)

windshield_rule: No film or darkening material on the windshield except to replace the sunshield in the uppermost area as installed by the vehicle manufacturer; since July 1, 2026 clear film is allowed if the windshield stays consistent with FMVSS 205 (S.B. 506, 2026 c. 894, 46.2-1052(F))
measured: film and glass together ('total light transmittance of such window')
tolerance: minus 7 percentage points for officer measurements (46.2-1052(E), 46.2-1053)
rear_window_condition: Tint film on any window requires a mirror on each side reflecting a view of the highway at least 200 ft to the rear

windshield_rule: Tint allowed along the top edge if the product is transparent and does not extend into the AS-1 portion of the windshield or more than 6 in from the top; clear film that reduces or blocks ultraviolet light may be applied to the windshield
measured: film and glass together ('net film screening' includes the manufacturer's material and any film added later)
rear_window_condition: Film on any window except the windshield requires outside mirrors on both sides showing the roadway at least 200 ft to the rear

windshield_rule: Strip only along the top, not below the 'ASI line' or more than 5 in from the top, whichever is closer to the top; must be nonreflective and not red, yellow or amber
measured: film: 'light transmission' is defined as light passing through 'a product or material'; the text does not say film and glass together
rear_window_condition: Film on glazing behind the driver requires one right and one left outside rear-view mirror

windshield_rule: Film or other nontransparent material only on the inside, outside the windshield critical area and above the horizontal line marked by the manufacturer's mark (printed in the code as "A" or "A."); if the windshield has no such mark, no film may be attached
measured: film and glass together ('the combination of the glazing and tinting film')
rear_window_condition: If the rear window transmits less than 60% of visible light, outside rear-view mirrors are required on the left and right sides
statutes: Wis. Admin. Code Trans 305.32; Wis. Admin. Code Trans 305.34; Wis. Admin. Code Trans 305.02; Wis. Admin. Code Trans 305.04; Wis. Stat. 110.075(7)

windshield_rule: Strip only along the top, not below the AS-1 line or more than 5 in from the top, whichever is closer to the top; must be nonreflective and not red, yellow or amber
measured: film and glass together ('through both the sunscreening device and glazing')
rear_window_condition: If film is added to any window behind the operator, one left and one right outside rear-view mirror are required
